01 / Context

The problem

Repeated test failures create manual investigation work and duplicate bug reports.

My contribution

Developed evidence collection, duplicate checks, and the healing/logging framework.

02 / Workflow

Workflow

  1. Capture an execution failure

    Collect failures from Eggplant automation runs.

  2. Gather evidence

    Collect diagnostic context for the failed execution.

  3. Check existing issues

    Compare against existing Jira tickets before reporting a new issue.

  4. Structure a new report

    Format a clean Jira ticket for a genuinely new issue.

03 / Architecture

Architecture

Test execution boundary

Eggplant supplies automated-test failures.

Evidence and duplicate checks

Collects diagnostics and checks Jira for duplicates. Matching details are confidential.

Jira logging and issue tracking

Connects test logs with Jira issue tracking.

Script-maintenance bridge

Links defect reporting to Script Change Management.

  • PostgreSQL
  • Vector DB
  • Transformers
  • Webhook
  • FastAPI

04 / Engineering decisions

Controls and trade-offs

Check before reporting

Check Jira before creating a report to reduce duplicates.

Collect context at the failure boundary

Collect diagnostics when a test fails to support triage.

Connect reporting to script maintenance

Feed defect context into the connected script-maintenance workflow.

05 / Status and evidence

Result

Deployed internally to connect test failures, diagnostic evidence, and Jira reporting.
